what_changed: STC Bank’s “Visa Card Rewards: iPhone 17 Pro and Apple Watch” changed status from “Expiring 8–30 Days” to “Expiring ≤7 Days.”
why_it_matters: The STC Bank prize campaign is now in its final reported expiry window.
Card and remittance campaigns account for 17 of the 22 active campaigns, concentrating activity around international fees, cashback and prizes.
Sixteen active campaigns have no stated end date, limiting visibility on when most current offers will close.
ai_summary.management_takeaway: The active inventory comprises 22 campaigns across five categories, led by cards and remittance. The only confirmed change is the STC Bank Visa rewards campaign moving into the ≤7-day expiry window; the broader inventory remains unchanged.

category_snapshot.summary: 9 active campaigns: STC Bank’s 0% international fees/free withdrawals, Visa device rewards, targeted international-purchase cash reward and credit-card launch cashback; barq’s zero travel fees; Mobily Pay’s summer fee, cashback and card-issuance offer; tiqmo’s zero international card and ATM fees; urpay’s Visa Platinum cashback game; and alinma pay’s zero international fees, free withdrawals and cashback.

8 active campaigns: barq’s zero-fee transfers and FX-rate awareness; Mobily Pay’s Aug–Oct zero-fee transfers and weekly prizes; tiqmo’s monthly transfer-streak cashback; urpay’s scratch-and-win offer; and alinma pay’s SAR 5 transfers plus zero-fee India transfers from SAR 700.
2 active barq campaigns: barq Marathon with a SAR 500,000 pool and 20,000 winners, and a prediction game with prizes worth up to SAR 500,000.
2 active campaigns: urpay’s salary-transfer travel-ticket draw and alinma pay’s draw offering three winners 100% cashback up to SAR 1,000.
1 active tiqmo campaign offering a daily draw for SAR 1,000 cashback.
